name: cable incline cross rear fly
description: A crossed-cable rear-delt fly performed while leaning back against an incline bench.
instructions: Set an incline bench between the cable stacks and sit with your back supported by the bench.
Take the opposite cable handle in each hand so the cables cross in front of you.
With elbows softly bent, pull the arms apart and back to the sides, squeezing the rear shoulders.
Return the handles slowly to the crossed start position.
